task: T1b occlusion score distributions + delta histograms (replaces hit-count-only occlusion report)

config.threshold_convention: CNNs: deployed d40 extrapolated thresholds; Proposed: quantile of prop_h0_stats at 1-1e-3 (the d45-battery convention)
config.windows: paired seed-42 in-distribution arm windows (500; sampler 141, rng 49)
config.occlusion: |f_D| +/-3-bin Doppler region of the VV channel zeroed (d45 mech probe 1)

notes: Delta = base - occluded; positive means the score DECREASED when the +/-3-bin tone region around the true f_D was zeroed, i.e. evidence that was localized in the tone region.
Cross-detector scale: CNN and NMF statistics live on different scales; delta_over_base_iqr_median is the scale-free comparison.

Phrasing guard (handoff): the interpretation is that CNN evidence is 'substantially driven by non-coherent features' wherever occlusion leaves the scores (and detections) largely intact; no 'energy detector' wording.
No detector re-run: all arrays are the saved d45_shift_battery.npz mechanism probes on the headline-grid windows.
